status: inferred design; not adopted or tested

recommendations.recommendation: Bounded hierarchical decomposition where independent subtasks justify it
recommendations.competing_option: Flat gated queue or single admitted coding session/scratchpad
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Same continuity/gates achieved with less review/cost by simpler baseline, or hierarchy increases stale work
recommendations.non_proof: Universal hierarchy advantage or removal of opt-in capabilities

recommendations.recommendation: Canonical novelty-bound retries and campaign-level replan/recovery ceilings
recommendations.competing_option: Fixed-step runbook with no semantic replan
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Novelty-renaming/reset admits a loop, or fixed runbook completes more verified work under same bounds
recommendations.non_proof: Semantic truth of a changed hypothesis

recommendations.recommendation: Resolve current canonical refs on wake; memory remains derived
recommendations.competing_option: Rehydrate full accepted event history rather than checkpoint/capsule acceleration
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Stale capsule changes authority or checkpoint loses accepted decisions
recommendations.non_proof: Better model recall or summary accuracy

recommendations.recommendation: Durable wake intents plus fresh kernel/effect admission
recommendations.competing_option: Demand-activated one-shot validation from canonical due state without long-lived claims
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Duplicate/lost delivery or manual trigger bypasses authority, expiry or exact-once logical admission
recommendations.non_proof: Exactly-once external effects or continuous availability

recommendations.recommendation: Compare resident, demand and workflow-assisted dispatch behind one contract
recommendations.competing_option: Owner-invoked batch as a conforming bounded measurement baseline; not replacement of accepted scheduling
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: All autonomous candidates add excessive cost/complexity without timely verified benefit, or cannot stay inert
recommendations.non_proof: Final scheduler/framework choice or semantic productivity

recommendations.recommendation: Fenced schedule reaping, named Stop boundary and per-member observation vector
recommendations.competing_option: Generation-fenced due-time rejection with bounded registry cleanup versus eager indexed schedule reaping, both preserving the same selected D022 scope/boundary and independent receiver evidence
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Stale timer/relauncher resumes work, false quiescence, or unrelated work killed
recommendations.non_proof: Remote rollback, complete OS containment or zero latency
recommendations.negative_control: Broader immediate interruption without separately authorized policy; never override the requested Aggressive, Full or Lazy scope/boundary

recommendations.recommendation: Route-neutral scheduling with operator-provisioned trusted harness launch
recommendations.competing_option: Individually approved native provider route with separately granted credentials
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Required route bypasses launch isolation/mediation or silently calls a helper
recommendations.non_proof: Legal clearance, entitlement or all-route compatibility

recommendations.recommendation: Disjoint settled/reserved cumulative ledger with unknown liability held
recommendations.competing_option: Entire campaign's worst-case allowance reserved up front
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Restart/fork resets budget, uncertainty double-counts liability, or missing bound permits spend
recommendations.non_proof: Exact subscription debit or optimal resource allocation

recommendations.recommendation: Explicit terminal/blocking predicates and verified-progress windows
recommendations.competing_option: Fixed-horizon batch plus mandatory end review, preserving all immediate safety and Stop checks
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Activity can prevent stopping forever or window stops useful work more often than batch at equal risk

recommendations.recommendation: One durable escalation with bounded projection notifications
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Required decision lost, wrong recipient/scope, notification storm or silence treated as approval
recommendations.non_proof: User attention/response or complete alert delivery

recommendations.recommendation: Exact approval-bound pre-effect mediation plus hard safety floors
recommendations.competing_option: Manual owner execution of all consequential effects
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Any replay/interrupt/route path dispatches before valid approval or revocation fence
recommendations.non_proof: Model alignment, injection immunity or unseen-route safety

recommendations.recommendation: Predeclared verified-obligation frontier and cost/continuity vector
recommendations.decisive_falsifier: Metric splitting/self-report/revision gaming improves score without accepted outcome
recommendations.non_proof: Causal productivity gain, universal metric or deployment safety
